items.summary: The Supreme Court on Wednesday held that a father facing prosecution under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act (POCSO Act) for sexual abuse of his son cannot be given custody of his children. A Bench of Justices JB Pardiwala and KV Viswanathan expressed alarm over the growing trend of warring spouses levelling false allegations of child sexual abuse against each other to gain tactical leverage in court. items.title: Full refund of court fee is legal entitlement when dispute is settled: Delhi High Court
items.summary: The Delhi High Court recently held that parties who amicably settle a suit, counterclaim or appeal are entitled to a full refund of the court fee paid and there is no need to file a separate application seeking refund [Hitech Enterprises v Modern Construction Company Delhi] .
